title: Dispersion, a lens bench
label: Lens bench: a domed, gridded glass disc in a knurled ring on a jointed arm arching from a column at the back of a long ruled plate; a bullseye probe at the rim sends red, green and blue rays to three ringed reads on a vernier.
caption: One probed pixel near the rim of the glass splits into three reads: the red, green and blue rays land a few ticks apart on the vernier, red 7.4 px from blue at b 0.985, and the spread shrinks as the probe moves in towards the centre.
